name: semantic-compression
title_zh: 电报体压缩器：把啰嗦指令压成密文
tagline_zh: 系统提示词、工具描述、技能正文越写越长？它把标点当连接词、删掉动词和废话，保留规范与精度，token 直降一半。
tagline_en: Prompts, tool schemas, skill bodies bloated? It rewrites into telegraphic register—punctuation as glue, verbs.
desc_en: Re-encode verbose prose into a dense telegraphic register — punctuation as connectives, label frames, verbless assertions — without losing normativity or precision. Use when compressing system prompts, tool/function descriptions, skill bodies, or agent instructions; reducing token count or context bloat; making documentation token-efficient for LLM input; or rewriting text in compressed notation.
why_zh: 不是简单删词，而是重编码语法：标签框架、无动词断言、标点即逻辑。压缩后仍可被 LLM 精确解析。
why_en: Not word removal—grammar re-encoding: label frames, verbless assertions, punctuation as logic. Stays LLM-parseable, keeps.
limit_zh: 只处理英文文本；中文标点与语序不适用。输出是电报体，人读费劲，需 LLM 消费。若原文含代码块或 JSON。
limit_en: English only; Chinese punctuation/word order unsupported. Output is for LLM consumption, not human reading. Code blocks/JSON may break—manual review.
title_en: Telegraphic compressor: dense prompts, no fluff
